collection: App-author example imported from workflow package

example.source: Published workflow → Try worked example; no case values changed.

actions: Import the app-author workflow package in a fresh temporary browser context.
Open Guided reviews → Try worked example.
Export the supplied unreviewed case for visitor download.
Review all 25 supplied answers under their assigned roles.
Evaluate and explicitly accept all five assessments using the published browser calculation workers.
Inspect saved reports using normal tabs, selectors, and chart controls.
Capture unedited DOM regions using browser screenshots.
Create a second worked case for the unreviewed download; both downloads have distinct saved-review identities.
Import both downloads into one fresh context using Published apps → Import app, workflow or case.
notes: Screenshots are direct browser captures; no interface labels, findings, styles or overlays were changed.
Review responsibility is recorded for a fictional demonstration. No verification was bought, shipment reserved, or release executed.
Element captures and explicit browser crops retain the visible report content; no bitmap editing was used.
Expected cost uses the example’s explicitly hypothetical 50/50 probability assessment, not record counts.

captures.state: The first next-review action identifies a task and role; selecting it does not accept the answer.
captures.description: The first next-review action identifies a task and role; selecting it does not accept the answer.
captures.alt: The fresh shipment workflow shows Next review step, the responsible shipment-lead role, and Review answer: Shipment identity and units. Other required review steps remain collapsed.
captures.caption: The next review task is explicit. Selecting it opens the required answer; it does not accept the answer, evaluate an assessment or authorize an operating action.

captures.state: Delivery commitment is available explicitly under Supporting findings.
captures.description: Delivery commitment is available explicitly under Supporting findings.
captures.alt: The app’s Delivery commitment section records DC-X, a November 17 noon reservation cutoff, November 20 at 5 p.m. receipt, 30 response minutes and 100 cases.
captures.caption: The delivery commitment is available on request beneath the decision brief. Its dates, quantity and response allowance are unchanged.

captures.state: Supported business proposals are separate from the next required review task.
captures.description: Supported business proposals are separate from the next required review task.

captures.state: Decision-first brief: supported proposals, with the complete supporting sections collapsed.
captures.description: Decision-first brief: supported proposals, with the complete supporting sections collapsed.
captures.alt: The current reviewed brief leads with the supported Backup proposal and fast verification, while Proposal details and Supporting findings stay collapsed until requested.
captures.caption: Business proposals lead the completed brief. Ordered review tasks guide an incomplete review; neither is an operating authorization.

captures.state: The required registration answer and remaining uncertainty lead; supporting explanations are on request.
captures.description: The required registration answer and remaining uncertainty lead; supporting explanations are on request.
captures.alt: The current evidence decision screen displays the registration question, remaining uncertainty and business explanation, with Why this finding? available for supporting explanations.
captures.caption: The business answer and its uncertainty lead. Possible explanations are available on request and do not supply probability weights.

captures.state: Backup is preferred; the compact comparison names the condition blocking Direct.
captures.description: Backup is preferred; the compact comparison names the condition blocking Direct.
captures.alt: The compact shipment decision prefers Backup at $6,000 and shows Direct at $4,000 blocked by Complete accepted order.
captures.caption: The default screen presents the supported choice and its blocker in business terms. The complete calculation remains available behind the decision.

captures.state: Direct’s selected option details retain the complete assignment, requirement results and failed condition by situation.
captures.description: Direct’s selected option details retain the complete assignment, requirement results and failed condition by situation.
captures.alt: Selected option details for Direct retain its assignment, mandatory requirement results and failed registration condition in the not_registered situation.
captures.caption: Selected details expose the failed condition without replacing the compact decision with the entire report by default.

captures.state: Acting now, expected improvement, investigation availability and the preferred timely check lead the learning decision.
captures.description: Acting now, expected improvement, investigation availability and the preferred timely check lead the learning decision.
captures.alt: The learning decision compares acting now at minus $6,000 with fast verification at minus $5,200, shows $800 expected improvement and leaves slow verification unavailable.
captures.caption: The decision-first learning view shows expected payoff after costs in dollars. The same finding is expressed as $5,200 expected cost and $800 expected improvement in the brief.

captures.state: Explicit complete-report inspection retains the fast/slow response timeline.
captures.description: Explicit complete-report inspection retains the fast/slow response timeline.
captures.alt: The live app’s review-timing timeline shows the fast response ready at minute 630 and the slow response ready at minute 870, after the reservation deadline.
captures.caption: The complete timing analysis remains available by explicit inspection. Its original minute values are unchanged: 630 is 10:30 a.m., 720 noon and 870 2:30 p.m.

uiRefresh.method: Unedited browser element screenshots after importing retained frozen artifacts through normal controls. Decisions lead; selected details and complete reports are opened explicitly. No results or interface content were injected.

details: Clicked the fresh next-review action, exported the native run and verified zero accepted answers and zero evaluations: navigation alone does not accept or calculate.
Evidence, commitment and learning use decision mode first; complete analysis remains explicitly reachable.
Retained reviewed run still contains all 25 accepted answers and five accepted evaluations; no review state was changed.
